758:t_1:317.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm sorry I'm late! $$ノノ$$... has just arrived!」

758:t_1:318.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You're late! We were supposed to meet ages ago!」

758:t_1:319.en:
$$チコ$$
「Do you realize that this delegation was arranged because you said you wanted to go to $$シリウス#keyword$$?」

758:t_1:320.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Of course! It might fundamentally change the way the universe works!」

758:t_1:321.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It could change the way the universe works?」

758:t_1:323.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Back when $$シリウス#keyword$$ and Earth were in contact, they tried to communicate with the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

758:t_1:325.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Why did you keep something that important to yourself!?」

758:t_1:326.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-I'm sorry, Big Sis! $$ノノ$$ only just remembered it recently!」

758:t_1:327.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ remembered that some $$宇宙怪獣$$ evolved in a completely different direction from that $$変動重力源$$.」

758:t_1:328.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$バアル$$... $$宇宙怪獣$$... are created by the force that seeks to vanish...」

758:t_1:329.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If they're intelligent and we can communicate with them...」

758:t_1:330.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then the clash between the force that seeks to exist and the force that seeks to vanish will change... In other words, the mechanism of the universe's collapse will change too.」

758:t_1:331.en:
$$ノノ$$
「See, Big Sis? It's just as $$ノノ$$ said, isn't it?」

758:t_1:332.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You only remembered something that important now...!」

758:t_1:333.en:
$$チコ$$
「Now, now... It sounds like that happened a very long time ago, so we don't know how things stand now...」

758:t_1:334.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We'll have to go to $$シリウス#keyword$$ to find out.」

758:t_1:335.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...Let's go, $$ノノ$$. Everyone is waiting for us.」

758:t_1:337.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Even with the old civilization's legacy, Earth's warp technology is still immature. It'll be a very long trip to $$シリウス#keyword$$.」

758:t_1:338.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ will be fine, as long as you're with her, Big Sis.」

758:t_1:341.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I promised, didn't I, $$ノノ$$? We'll always be together.」

758:t_1:342.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes, Big Sis! Forever, wherever we go!」

758:t_1:343.en:
$$ノノ$$
(And someday... we'll see everyone again too, won't we...?)

758:t_1:348.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Looks like you've woken up, Brat $$シンジ$$.」

758:t_1:350.en:
$$カヲル$$
「As you can see, we're in our own world.」

758:t_1:351.en:
$$マリ$$
「That super-dimensional repair put the world back the way it was and brought us home too, nya~.」

758:t_1:352.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「We came back with the EVAs.」

758:t_1:354.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Well... Now that Brat $$シンジ$$ is awake, Four-Eyes and I are leaving.」

758:t_1:356.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Isn't it obvious? We're going to rejoin $$ヴィレ$$.」

758:t_1:357.en:
$$マリ$$
「That's right. Our little game of being friends ends here.」

758:t_1:359.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I thought saving the universe might have changed you a little, but you're still moping...」

758:t_1:361.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What are you going to do now?」

758:t_1:362.en:
$$マリ$$
「Will you come to $$ヴィレ$$? That's where you were supposed to end up, after all.」

758:t_1:364.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Make up your mind! What do you want to do!?」

758:t_1:366.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I want to think about it because I don't know.」

758:t_1:368.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... In that case, you probably don't want to go to $$ヴィレ$$ and be detained.」

758:t_1:370.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I understand what you're thinking. ...We're leaving, then.」

758:t_1:372.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't talk to me like we're friends. From here on, we're enemies again.」

758:t_1:374.en:
$$マリ$$
「Bye-bye. I'd rather not meet you on the battlefield, if I can help it.」

758:t_1:377.en:
$$カヲル$$
「They're going their own way... Let's go too.」

758:t_1:379.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「That's for you to decide.」

758:t_1:381.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I don't know what lies ahead... But I can't just do nothing...)

758:t_1:382.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I'll... move forward... Even if it's only one step at a time, I'll make my own choices...)

758:t_1:386.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Another clear day in $$パラダイムシティ$$. It's hard to believe the sky used to be cloudy every day.」

758:t_1:387.en:
$$ノーマン$$
「Indeed, sir. I shall leave today's morning paper here.」

758:t_1:388.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「If that thug $$ベック$$ has caused another commotion, it'll spoil my good mood...」

758:t_1:389.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ロジャー$$... A client is here.」

758:t_1:390.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「It's been a while, $$ロジャー$$.」

758:t_1:391.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never expected you to be my client...」

758:t_1:393.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「No... A visit from a beautiful woman is always welcome.」

758:t_1:394.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「Thank you. That makes it easier for me to explain.」

758:t_1:395.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It sounds as though you're bringing me quite a difficult problem...」

758:t_1:396.en:
$$エンジェル$$
「Will you turn me down, then?」

758:t_1:397.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ロジャー$$ would never do that. He always sees a job through.」

758:t_1:398.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, $$ドロシー#bigo$$. I'll do my utmost to live up to your expectations.」

758:t_1:399.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(My name is $$ロジャー・スミス$$... I'm this city's negotiator...)

758:t_1:400.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(This is $$パラダイムシティ$$... We have neither memories nor a past, but I believe a bright future awaits both this city and me...)

758:t_1:401.en:
$$ロジャー$$
(We'll have a tomorrow as bright as today's weather... I'd like the friends who will visit us someday to see these clear skies too.)

758:t_1:405.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「...$$セツコ$$. Have you finished the data we're submitting?」
